prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1384; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Appraiser's remarks: The right rear quarter panel and rear bumper cover show scuffing, a cracked corner of the bumper cover, and a dented lower door skin consistent with a sideswipe during a lane change. It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact, so the rear bumper support area should be checked once the cover is off. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known. The bills show no repeated charges, and the repair labor hours fit the damage described. Plan: repair and refinish the quarter panel, replace the bumper cover, and blend adjacent panels for color match.
